name: What are the benefits of converting a garage versus building an addition?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of converting a garage versus building an addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing garage often leverages existing foundations, walls, and roofing, which can make it a more cost-effective and faster alternative to building a new home addition from the ground up. It also utilizes existing space, avoiding changes to your property's footprint. However, an addition offers more flexibility in design and size. When considering which option is best, Maine Results, Inc. helps evaluate your budget, space requirements, and desired outcome to make an informed decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions can be more cost-effective and faster than new additions, utilizing existing structures, but additions offer more design flexibility.
